draft.text: You came in because you have a rash on your face, mainly around your cheeks and under your nose.
You said it started a while ago and you've been using doxycycline and a cream.
The rash is red with small bumps.
It doesn't itch or hurt, but it feels sensitive to the touch.
You've been using a metro cream after washing your face, and the rash hasn't gotten worse.
The rash has not improved much since you started taking doxycycline once a day.
You're concerned about using Elidel cream, but you haven't had any allergic reactions.
Your doctor will review your treatment plan and may change it.
You'll need to come back for a follow-up to check on the rash and adjust treatment if needed.
